# NumberField props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labels` | `Partial<NumberFieldLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_NUMBER_FIELD_LABELS`. `aria-label` and `aria-roledescription` on a part take precedence. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `increment` | `string` | `"Increase"` | Name of `NumberField.Increment`. |
| `decrement` | `string` | `"Decrease"` | Name of `NumberField.Decrement`. |
| `roleDescription` | `string` | `"Number field"` | The `aria-roledescription` of `NumberField.Input`, which a screen reader reads as its role. |
